annotation_policy: Join annotations after geometric scoring; no functional mask, penalty, tier/rank modification or combined score. No silent exclusion of functionally annotated sites.

display_policy.full_results: Every attempted source residue with original status/reason; separately retain absent full-polymer positions -5 through 3.
display_policy.ties: Existing minimum/competition ranks. For each top-10 list include all sites tied at the tenth order statistic; report actual list size.
display_policy.overview: Union of the three inclusive top-10 lists, display in structural identity order; not a composite ordering.
display_policy.functional_context: Separate all 11 annotated sites regardless of geometric result; retain background checks Q376/R377. Preserve original cautions and all failed/skipped rows.
display_policy.no_optimization: No selection against expected scores, no second input scan, no experimental probability or performance claim.

pre_scan_requirements: Maintainer review of the recommended 2O9P engineered apo case and numbering discrepancy.
